subject: ggtree with pie charts in facets

messages.author: 8de2368740661a0e
messages.subject: ggtree with pie charts in facets
parts:
Hello,

I am really glad with ggtree, but I get stuck with what I want to do. I hope that someone can help me here.

I would like to plot pie charts, that vary in size relative to the sample size and are already facetted, next to my tree. I hoped that facet_plot would work, but I am not able to make it work. I have the very simple code below and I am sorry but I am just lost. Plotting the tree and the pie-charts separately works, but I cannot get it working together. Thank you very much in advance for your help.

My best,
Setareh 


test <- read.table("ETBiosynthesis_SyntelogsHomologsPercentages_180622.txt", header =TRUE)


tree <- read.tree("tree_nexus.txt")


blank_theme <- theme_minimal()+ theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank(),panel.border = element_blank(),panel.grid=element_blank(),axis.ticks = element_blank(), plot.title=element_blank())


pie <- ggplot(test,aes(x=Size/2,y=Percentage,fill=Group,width = Size)) + geom_bar(position ="fill",stat="identity") + facet_grid(Species ~ PFAM) + coord_polar("y",start=0) + blank_theme + theme(axis.text.x=element_blank()) + scale_fill_manual(values=c("Syntelogs"='khaki2','Homologs'='black')) 


facet_plot(boom,panel='bar',data=test,geom = geom_bar,aes(x=Size/2,y=Percentage,fill=Group,width = Size))
